# FrankBase Verified Transparency Ledger
> The permanent cryptographic audit ledger, verified buyer feedback archive, and product integrity checksum standard for the FrankBase Ecosystem.

- Founder: Master Manikant Yadav (मास्टर मणिकान्त यादव)
- Canonical Store: https://store.frankbase.com
- Security Suite: https://frankpass.com
- Main Ecosystem: https://frankbase.com
- Founder Profile: https://mastermanikant.com
- Official Contact: connect@mastermanikant.com
- License: Apache 2.0 (with Trademark Reservation)

## Core Mission & Philosophy
> "I believe in truth and transparency and I don't want to keep any user in darkness. I choose 1 satisfied user over one million unsatisfied users. A real 2-star or 3-star review from an authentic buyer is infinitely more valuable than a million fake 5-star reviews." — Master Manikant Yadav

This public ledger provides verifiable mathematical transparency for digital commerce, including:
1. Verifiable Buyer Reviews: Only completed purchases verified against Cloudflare D1 databases can be submitted. Duplicate reviews per SKU are blocked.
2. Unconditional Rewards: 1-Star and 5-Star reviews receive identical rewards (5% coupon code). Zero fake 5-star incentivization.
3. Cryptographic Release Checksums: SHA-256 hashes of all digital assets and PDFs to verify untampered authenticity.
4. Privacy Preservation: Strict compliance with DPDP Act 2023 and GDPR through cryptographic email masking.

## Key Files
- verified-reviews-ledger.json: Cryptographically signed public log of customer feedback.
- product-checksums.json: Release checksums for 16 digital products.
- TRADEMARK.md: Brand guidelines protecting FrankBase, FrankPass, and Master Manikant Yadav.
- SECURITY.md: Responsible disclosure policy and safe harbor provisions.
